entries.text: Everybody’s here—well, most of us are here,\nanyway.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_02

entries.text: Now then, the caretaker has some words for us.\nLet’s all give him our full attention![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_03

entries.text: Ah, yes. Thank you for coming.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_01

entries.text: I’ve been told that our student pairs have now\nfinished visiting all the signboards in Kitakami...\r\nwhich means your self-guided tour is at an end![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_02

entries.text: Hear that? We did it! We found ’em all!
entries.label: sdc01_0020_student1_01

entries.text: That was so much fun!
entries.label: sdc01_0020_student2_01

entries.text: Why, thank you for saying so! And thanks for\ntaking part![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_03

entries.text: On that note, I’ve got a little gift for each of you.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_04

entries.text: You received the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Kitakami Mochi Set[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the\ncaretaker!
entries.label: sdc01_0485_system_01

entries.text: You put the Kitakami Mochi Set in your Bag’s\n[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Other Items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] pocket.
entries.label: sdc01_0485_system_02

entries.text: Truth be told, I didn’t think you’d wrap up the\ntour this quickly. You’re quite the prodigies![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_05

entries.text: Our visitors from Paldea still have heaps of time\nleft to enjoy Kitakami and all it has to offer.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_06

entries.text: Continue to make yourselves at home and\nexplore as you please.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_07

entries.text: However...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_08

entries.text: I’m sorry for suddenly springing this on you, but\nCarmine, Kieran, and I will need to return to\r\nBlueberry Academy a little early.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_04

entries.text: Oh no!
entries.label: sdc01_0485_select_01

entries.text: But why?
entries.label: sdc01_0485_select_02

entries.text: Again, truly sorry, but there have been some\ndevelopments concerning the Great Crater.\c\nI’m afraid we really must be heading back.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_05

entries.text: I realize I was here as your chaperone, but you\nkids have all proven to be very capable.\c\nI’m sure you’ll be fine without me.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_06

entries.text: Thank you so much for looking after them in\nmy stead.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_07

entries.text: Don’t mention it. You can leave these kids to me![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_09

entries.text: Now then... Carmine, I believe you had\nsomething you wanted to say?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_08

entries.text: Unfortunately my brother’s not feeling well, so\nit’s just me here to speak...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_03

entries.text: Anyway, as you all know, this village is where I\nwas born.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_04

entries.text: And I’ll be honest—I didn’t want any outsiders\ncoming here at all![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_05

entries.text: Yikes...
entries.label: sdc01_0020_student1_02

entries.text: It felt like our home was being turned into a\ntourist trap for a buncha ignorant strangers...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_06

entries.text: But then we spent some time together, and none\nof you were the way I imagined you’d be at all...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_07

entries.text: You were all really nice once I actually talked\nto you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_08

entries.text: I shouldn’t have been so quick to judge people\nI didn’t know anything about.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_09

entries.text: So I guess what I’m trying to say is...I had fun!\nThank you all so much for visiting our village![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_10

entries.text: Especially you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_11

entries.text: I’m glad you came to visit.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_12

entries.text: I mean, it’s not like this is good-bye forever...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_13

entries.text: Blueberry Academy has tons of strong Trainers!\nYou’d better come visit soon![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_14

entries.text: Oh, I almost forgot—I still need to get packed\nand everything![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_15

entries.text: This is NOT good-bye, OK? We’re definitely\ngonna see each other again![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_sister_16

entries.text: That’s Carmine for you, I suppose... You never\nknow quite what to expect from her.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_caretaker_10

entries.text: Each moment spent with you kids is just dazzling.\nFor an adult like me? Heh... It’s almost blinding.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_09

entries.text: Anyway, that about wraps up this school trip![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_10

entries.text: Let’s all give our caretaker a great big thank-you![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0485_bbteacher_11

entries.text: Thaaank yooouuu!
entries.label: sdc01_0485_all_01
